title: NumLang: A Formally Verified, Self-Applicable Process-Tree Supercompiler for Systems Languages
description: Artifact evaluation package and complete source distribution for NumLang, featuring an SSA process-tree supercompiler, Lean 4 formal machine-checked proofs of soundness and termination, and a comprehensive 18-benchmark literature evaluation suite comparing against Rustc -O3, MSVC /O2, GHC -O2, and HOSC (with automatic toolchain detection and graceful skip for unavailable compilers).
